main_claims: It is possible to use deep learning to accurately predict road safety directly from raw satellite imagery. A deep learning-based mapping approach is proposed that leverages open data to learn from raw satellite imagery robust deep models able to predict accurate city-scale road safety maps at an affordable cost.; Proposing a deep learning-based mapping approach for predicting city-scale road safety maps from raw satellite imagery; Proposing the idea of obtaining labeled satellite images from open data; Making publicly available a deep model for predicting road safety learned from over 647 thousand traffic-accident reports collected by the NYPD; Predicting for the city of Denver a city-scale road safety map with an accuracy of 73%.; The proposed work is the first to attempt using machine learning to predict city-scale road safety maps directly from raw satellite imagery. The work aims to generate maps that help inform city-planning decision-making and policy and eventually improve road safety for cities where proper data collection is unaffordable.
